# Frontier_Base_Self_Sustainment

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A logistics concept where forward bases use autonomous, localized resource generation and repair, decoupled from central supply chains. This requires TCC-based distributed computing and in-network intelligence to manage resource allocation and predictive maintenance at the edge.
